cs.t: This. At one company we ran out of space in the server room, so the excess machine temporarily landed next to my desk. Dear god. Noise cancelling headphones couldn't cope with the noise.
cs.th: Motherboard sales are now collapsing amid unprecedented shortages fueled by AI

cs.t: Personal anecdote: I have tinnitus and noise-cancelling headphones sets it off worse than regular headphones.  As in, I always have a constant low-level ringing, but certain triggers can 10X or 100X the intensity.  As a developer, I was a heavy user of noise canceling headphones before this.
cs.th: Are noise-cancelling headphones to blame for young people's hearing problems?
